gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kadwa: Bold and commanding up top, Turret Road leans on round forms. Kadwa follows with open-ended curves and a tall lowercase, giving the pair a confident classic serif voice beneath the headline.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noticia-text: Turret Road draws round, parenthesis-like forms with a pen's constant line. Noticia Text answers with a serif that has wide entrances into its curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so the heading stays blunt while the text feels literary.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-piazzolla: Turret Road bends its rounded letters like neon tubing, every stroke the same thickness from start to finish. And Piazzolla, a classic serif with lowercase close to its capitals and a widely opened e, would carry a long passage with refined authority.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-pridi: Pridi reads tall and generous, its small letters standing almost as high as capitals. Pridi leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so nudging its size up a touch makes it even more welcoming beside Turret Road's vinyl-cut roundness.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-scope-one: Glyphs that look cut from strips of equal width, round like open parentheses, define Turret Road's bold, commanding look up top. Scope One brings traditional, refined text with spill-out counters.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-slabo-13px: Turret Road keeps stroke edges parallel through every curve, so its round forms feel bold and commanding on the page. Slabo 13px gives long text a bookish text serif with large open counters.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-suwannaphum: One line of constant width, with no thin spots or swelling, gives Turret Road its commanding roundness. And Suwannaphum, a dignified classic serif with a high, squared-off x-height, would look best with a little extra size.
gen-gf-twinkle-star-fs-bespoke-sans: Twinkle Star writes tight, casual pen letters whose curves open outward, and it handles graceful display work best. But Bespoke Sans is the sharper one, a plain sans with generous space around its curves, and it is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-twinkle-star-fs-literata: Graceful and casual, Twinkle Star scribbles tight pen-like letters up top. Literata brings a bookish classic serif underneath, its thin and thick lines and wide-mouthed curves made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-epunda-slab: Loud, stout, horseshoe-round lettering. Underdog holds every stroke at pipe-cleaner thickness and shouts its expressive side, while Epunda Slab turns dignified, a classic serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase.
